thought_path_snapshot: Implement a recursive function with memoization to efficiently count numbers containing the power of 2 by breaking down the problem into counting occurrences in smaller ranges and combining results.
Use dynamic programming to build up the count of numbers containing the power of 2 based on smaller subproblems.
Brute force approach by iterating through all numbers from 0 to n and checking if they contain the power of 2 as a substring.
